_about: What verify/from-json.js cannot fill mechanically for fellhammer-siege-task-force, written by hand and read by it on every run (from-json.js --write gives the same data.js again). gists: a stratagem's one-line summary (the app's own words: its EFFECT shortened, its WHEN/TARGET condition kept, nothing added); def: its When targeted line; both AI-written (Claude, 24 Oct 2026) with the fingerprint (gistOf, defOf) of the text they were written from, so a changed source text fails the gate's fingerprints step. mod: a stratagem's weapon footnote (hand). armyRules: Dark Pacts' Damage-tab reading (calcMods, the player's pick; both: what lets a unit take both abilities). fixes: GW's Faction Pack words where Wahapedia's transcription differs. units: per unit entry, its abilities' When targeted lines (def, AI-written, with defOf), its weapon footnotes (mods), its auras (only what GW tags (Aura), Core Rules 22.01), stats values a rule of the list gives that New Recruit's export does not show, and keywords a rule of the list gives that BSData's entry and the export lack. Each is a judgement verify/helpers.js lists for sign-off.

Dark Pacts.why: the Damage tab: a Dark Pact is the player's choice each time the unit is selected to shoot or fight (Leadership test first; failed: D3 mortal wounds), and which ability it gains is theirs to pick; Touch of the Arkifane lets it select both

calcMods.when: A Dark Pact made when selected to shoot or fight (Leadership test first; failed: D3 mortal wounds), until the end of the phase

fixes.why: GW Faction Pack Chaos Space Marines p3, Pact of Destruction: "… if those attacks destroyed an enemy model, this unit heals 3 wounds." (Wahapedia's transcription drops the full stop)

cult-of-the-arkifane/touch-of-the-arkifa.gist: Your HERETIC ASTARTES unit (not DAMNED) that has not shot or fought this phase: until the end of the phase, if it makes a Dark Pact, you can select both abilities for its weapons to gain.

cult-of-the-arkifane/balefire-boon.gist: Your SOUL FORGE unit that has not shot or fought this phase: until the end of the phase, its attacks have +1 AP.

mod.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, until the end of the phase

cult-of-the-arkifane/soul-tally-offering.gist: Your SOUL FORGE unit that has not shot or fought this phase: until the end of the phase, its attacks that target a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit can re-roll the wound roll.

mod.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, until the end of the phase, vs CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE units

cult-of-the-arkifane/biomechanoid-regene.gist: Your Command phase: one model in your HERETIC ASTARTES unit (not DAMNED) regains up to D3 lost wounds, or up to 3 if your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword.

cult-of-the-arkifane/forge-fire-surge.gist: Your Movement phase, just after your HERETIC ASTARTES unit Advances: until the end of the turn it is eligible to shoot, or, if it has the SOUL FORGE keyword, to shoot and declare a charge.

cult-of-the-arkifane/unholy-fortitude.gist: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets: your SOUL FORGE unit it targets has +1 T until the end of the phase.
cult-of-the-arkifane/unholy-fortitude.def: their Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selected it as a target: +1 T until the end of the phase

devotees-of-destruction/ruinations-bount.gist: Your Shooting phase, your HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit is selected to shoot: when it uses the Dark Pacts ability, its ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

mod.when: Your Shooting phase, selected to shoot, when your unit uses the Dark Pacts ability

devotees-of-destruction/snare-of-fire.gist: Your opponent’s Movement phase, an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of your unengaged HAVOCS unit: your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

devotees-of-destruction/undying-hatred.gist: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, an enemy unit targets your HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit: attacks that target your unit with a S greater than its T have -1 to the wound roll.
devotees-of-destruction/undying-hatred.def: their Shooting phase: -1 to wound when the attack’s S is greater than its T

Reorder Reality.def: an enemy unit within 18" targets him: -1 to hit rolls, and its ranged weapons have [HAZARDOUS] until the end of the phase

dark-apostle-master-of-executions-nemesi.why: Cybinfernal Font (the Dark Apostle's): models in the bearer's unit have the SOUL FORGE keyword, every model of the attached unit (19.04); Soul Forge Boons: SOUL FORGE units have a 5+ invulnerable save. New Recruit's export shows none for the Master of Executions and the Nemesis Claw. Dark Zealotry, Warp-sighted Butcher and Visions of Suffering: every model of the attached unit (19.04, its FAQ: “A rule that applies to ’this/that unit’ … applies to all models in an attached unit”).
dark-apostle-master-of-executions-nemesi.statsEvidence: verify/.cache/waha/chaos-space-marines.txt, Cult of the Arkifane: Cybinfernal Font "Models in the bearer’s unit have the SOUL FORGE keyword." and Soul Forge Boons "SOUL FORGE units from your army have a 5+ invulnerable save."; GW Faction Pack Chaos Space Marines p7 (the same words); Core Rules 19.04 (Wahapedia core rules): "abilities/rules that affect a unit (or models in it) apply to every model in an attached unit"; verify/sources/nr-json/fellhammer-siege-task-force.json: Master of Executions and Nemesis Claw InSv "-".

mods.note: can ignore any or all modifiers to BS and any or all modifiers to the hit roll

Allocated to a MONSTER or VEHICLE model

kw.why: Soul Forge Boons (Cult of the Arkifane): “HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE … units from your army gain the SOUL FORGE keyword.” The Forgefiend is a HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE (GW's datasheet: KEYWORDS VEHICLE, WALKER, …; FACTION KEYWORDS HERETIC ASTARTES); BSData's Forgefiend lacks the hidden "Heretic Astartes Vehicle" category every other CSM vehicle entry has, so its modifier does not reach it.
kw.evidence: verify/.cache/waha/chaos-space-marines.txt, Cult of the Arkifane, Soul Forge Boons: "HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE, LORD DISCORDANT and VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE units from your army gain the SOUL FORGE keyword."; GW Faction Pack Chaos Space Marines p7 (the same words); verify/.cache/waha/ds/chaos-space-marines_Forgefiend.html: KEYWORDS VEHICLE; WALKER; CHAOS; DAEMON; FORGEFIEND, FACTION KEYWORDS HERETIC ASTARTES; verify/sources/nr-json/fellhammer-siege-task-force.json: Forgefiend categories without "Heretic Astartes Vehicle" and "Soul Forge" (the Maulerfiend and the Vindicator have both).
